regimeSub: Retail sales miss deepens goldilocks bid; Warsh on hold as growth slows faster than inflation.
themes: July retail sales post largest drop in 12 months (Aug 14) → consumer exhaustion confirms Q3 GDP tracking sub-1.5%; Fed hike cycle definitively dead, Sept hold locked in
BOK Deputy Gov Yu (Aug 11) hawkish guidance intact → August hike odds rising as KRW stability trumps growth; USDKRW grinding lower to 1411 on rate divergence
BOJ-Takaichi JGB stress (Reuters Aug 10) unresolved → USDJPY stuck at 159 as Bessent Sept hike nudge loses traction; carry trade fragility persists but no immediate unwind catalyst
Gold $4454 catching bid on retail miss → stagflation-lite fears resurface despite Brent capped at $88 post-OPEC+ expansion; safe haven rotation from equities at margin
